acceptance.criterion: Remote control is OFF by default and requires explicit local Human pairing of one repository, actor and opaque host; local disable cannot silently re-enable.

evidence.contains: pairing requires exact local Human consent

acceptance.criterion: Only an authenticated GitHub issue from the paired actor with exact label, host, title, parameters, nonce and short expiry maps to start/status/stop.
GitHub prose never becomes a shell command, and a private create-once reservation prevents duplicate or uncertain work from replaying.

evidence.contains: never treats issue prose as a shell command

acceptance.criterion: Public results preserve runner state and cannot claim browser UAT, independent verification, model dispatch, cancellation acknowledgement or merge eligibility without matching evidence.

constraints: The authenticated GitHub CLI transport is exercised with deterministic stubs, not a live owner-device command issue.
Poll-once is explicit and bounded; automatic Windows service startup and remote offline heartbeat are not implemented.
Existing exact-head Windows UAT admission and local stop semantics remain authoritative.
Browser UAT, Pi/Cline repair dispatch, independent verification and merge remain outside this increment.
